_comment: Camera (flight_core::camera::CameraTuning). Assumed values. chase_offset: seated camera in ship space (x right, y up, z back, m); chase_pitch_deg: its pitch against the nose (negative looks down). fov_curve: speed m/s -> vertical FOV deg. streak_curve: speed m/s -> speed dust level (0 none, 0.2 and more full thickness). Look-ahead: the view leads a turn by gain x turn rate, past the dead zone (rad/s), capped, eased. Bump: touchdown drop per m/s of approach speed, damped; the bump comes when the hull starts touching, if the approach speed just before was above bump_threshold m/s. Shake (#148, F9 switch, default on; camera_shake in settings scales it): trauma 0..1 from boost, thrust share and touchdown (per m/s approach), decays linearly, offset = smooth noise times trauma squared, bounded. TODO(initiator): every shake_*, lag_* and g_fov_curve value is a placeholder to tune by feel. Lag (#149): the chase camera trails the felt acceleration (the change of velocity in ship space: no gravity term, so a hover feels nothing; zero on the ground): lag_per_g m per g, a spring with lag_stiffness (1/s2) and lag_damping (1/s), bounded by lag_max. g_fov_curve: forward felt G to extra field of view (deg).
